_comment: Alba allocator strategy config — WS5 DRY-RUN. Every knob is documented in README.md (Config reference). '_'-prefixed keys are inline docs (ignored by the bot). Amounts are whole USDC.
_simulatedAumUSDC: Paper-trading AUM seeded into state.json on first run (or --reset). Dry-run only; live mode reads vault state on-chain.
_buckets: Maturity ladder targets, % of NAV. Sum of targetWeightPct + bufferTargetPct should be 100. Paper beyond the last bucket's maxDays is ineligible.
_bufferTargetPct: MetaMorpho floating buffer target, % of NAV (PRODUCT.md v1: ~20% liquid buffer). Rebalanced toward this after buys each run.
_bufferTolerancePct: No rebalance while |buffer - target| is within this % of NAV (avoids churn).
_minSpreadBps: Minimum spread of a bond's executable yield OVER the floating benchmark before a standing borrower offer is worth taking. The core 'is fixed paying us for term?' test.
_perMaturityMaxPctOfAum: Concentration cap: max % of NAV in any single maturity date.
_perMaturityMaxPctOfBookDepth: Depth cap: never take more than this % of a book's visible executable (ask-side) depth in one run — we must not BE the market.
_maxSingleBuyUSDC: Max cash spent on a single buy decision (one market, one run).
_minClipUSDC: Dust floor for a buy: if the sized clip comes out below this, skip (mirrors rates MIN_DEPTH_USDC = $5k).
_minBookDepthUSDC: A market's ask side must have at least this much live, unexpired depth to be considered at all ($5k dust floor).
_minDaysToMaturity: Skip paper maturing sooner than this (not worth the gas/ops).
_maxDaysToMaturity: Skip paper maturing later than this (ladder horizon).
_fallbackFloatingAprPct: Floating benchmark used when GRAPH_API_KEY is unset (dry-run without secrets). Sanity-check against the rates dashboard (borrow-weighted median of Base USDC venues).
_fallbackBufferSupplyAprPct: Simulated MetaMorpho buffer supply APR when GRAPH_API_KEY is unset (accrues the paper buffer between runs).
_staleLockMinutes: A .lock older than this is considered stale and stolen (crash recovery for cron).
_maxMarketPages: Max pages to walk on the Midnight /markets endpoint (100 markets/page, sorted by size desc).
